interpretation.headline: Failure-class fixes clear fresh2 as reused-set regression evidence; this is not fresh generalization evidence.
interpretation.burned_result_use: The 16-item 2026_08 holdout is burned; its latest run is regression evidence only. Groundedness regressed on three burned rows and must be watched, but fresh2 groundedness is clean.
interpretation.fresh2_result_use: Fresh2 was already burned by earlier committed runs. The 834cba3 run is reused-set regression evidence after the CJK retrieval, router, and eval RAG prompt fixes; a successor holdout is required for any new generalization claim.
interpretation.next_step: Freeze implementation, create a successor holdout with new question phrasings and provenance, run it once, and stop rather than tuning against it.

limitations: Fresh2 has multiple committed runs and is no longer fresh; these metrics are regression evidence on a reused holdout.
Fresh2 was created after inspecting the burned set failure classes; it tests coverage of related failure classes but is not independent of the chosen failure taxonomy.

The relevance denominator contains only answerable positive queries because run_eval does not perform diagnostic retrieval for unanswerable rows; this run measures retrieval sensitivity, not negative-query specificity.
Direct-control rows f001/f002 used min_hits=1, so their contains_pass result should be read with the recorded answer text, not as a standalone behavioral-proof metric.
Route-only and full-pipeline runs use live Gemini output, so exact answer wording may vary across reruns.
